en.name: Baby food jars and pouches
en.summary: A jar and a pouch hold much the same purée and fail in quite different ways, which is what this covers. A sealed one of either is a commercially heat-processed pack and keeps to the use-by date printed on it. Once opened and covered, both keep 2–3 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below — 2 for savoury and vegetable contents, 3 for acidic fruit — and only if nobody has eaten out of the container itself.
en.pantry: Unopened, these live in the cupboard until the printed date, kept cool, dark and upright; that date is the maker's statement about their own pack and there is no separate figure to give. The two formats fail differently, so check them differently. A glass jar tells you a great deal: the button in the lid should be down and should not click, the rim should be free of rust, and the lid should pop audibly the first time you twist it — no pop, no vacuum. A pouch tells you almost nothing, because you cannot see inside it; what you can do is feel it. A pouch should be limp. Any puffiness is gas from something growing, and a pouch carried loose in a bag can be pinholed by a set of keys without looking damaged at all.
en.fridge: Opened and covered at 4 °C (40 °F) or below: 2–3 days, at the short end for meat, dinners and vegetables and the long end for fruit, whose acidity does some of the work. Stand an opened jar with its own lid back on, and decant a pouch into a lidded pot, because a folded-over spout does not seal and the contents take up whatever is sitting nearest in the fridge. The spoon rule decides everything else: a spoon that has been in the baby's mouth and then back into the container ends that container's life on the spot, and a pouch sucked straight from the spout is the same problem with the saliva delivered more directly. Portion into a bowl, feed from the bowl, throw away the remainder in the bowl.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is published for an opened jar or pouch, and none should be invented. Commercial purée separates into liquid and solids when thawed and never quite comes back together. Freezing your own purée in an ice cube tray and bagging the cubes is a reasonable habit, and the cube is a useful unit: roughly one small portion, so you thaw only what the baby will actually eat. Label the bag. Nothing thawed, warmed or fed from goes back into the freezer.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, not on the worktop, and warm the portion a single time. Stir it through and test it on the inside of your wrist — purée reheated in a microwave holds hot spots that one stir will not always find.
spoilage: A vacuum button that clicks when pressed — discard the jar without opening it.
A swollen, leaking or damaged pouch, or any hissing or spurting on opening.
A sour, fermented or off smell, or fizzing in the purée.
Mould around the rim, under the lid or at the spout.
tips: Always spoon a portion into a bowl rather than feeding from the container.
Write the date and time on the jar when you open it.
Check the vacuum button and the pouch seams before every use.
Never give honey to a baby under one year old — it can carry the spores that cause infant botulism.

faq.q: How long does an opened jar or pouch of baby food keep?
faq.a: 2–3 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, and only if it has never been fed from directly.

faq.q: Can you feed a baby straight from the jar?
faq.a: Only if the whole jar will be finished in that feed. Once a used spoon or the baby's mouth touches it, the rest must be thrown away.

faq.q: What should you check before opening a jar of baby food?
faq.a: Press the vacuum button — it should not click. Check a pouch for swelling, leaks or damage, and discard anything that hisses or spurts when opened.

zh.name: 嬰兒副食品罐與軟袋
zh.summary: 玻璃罐和軟袋裝的往往是同一種泥，壞掉的方式卻很不一樣，而這裡談的就是這件事。兩者未開封時都是經過商業加熱處理的包裝，可以放到上面印的有效日期。開封後蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏，兩種都是 2～3 天——鹹口味和蔬菜抓 2 天，酸性的水果可以到 3 天——而且前提是沒有人直接就著容器吃過。
zh.pantry: 未開封的就放在櫥櫃裡到標示日期為止，陰涼、避光、立著放；那個日期是廠商對自家包裝的說法，我們不另外給數字。這兩種容器壞掉的方式不一樣，檢查的方式也要跟著不同。玻璃罐會告訴你很多事：蓋子中央的鈕應該是凹下去而且按不動，罐口不該生鏽，第一次轉開時應該聽得到啵一聲——沒有那一聲，就代表真空已經沒了。軟袋幾乎什麼都不會告訴你，因為你看不進去；你能做的是用手捏。軟袋應該是軟塌的，只要鼓鼓的就是裡面有氣、有東西在長。另外，軟袋在提袋裡跟鑰匙擠在一起，可能被戳出根本看不出來的針孔。
zh.fridge: 開封後蓋好放 4 °C 以下：2～3 天，肉類、主餐和蔬菜抓短的那一端，水果因為有酸度可以抓長的那一端。玻璃罐就用原本的蓋子蓋回去；軟袋請倒進有蓋的小盒，因為把袋口折起來根本沒有密封，內容物會把冰箱裡最近的味道全吸進去。其餘由湯匙那條規則決定：進過寶寶嘴巴的湯匙只要回到容器裡，那個容器當場結束；直接用嘴吸軟袋口是同一件事，只是口水送得更直接。請分裝到碗裡、從碗裡餵，碗裡剩下的丟掉。
zh.freezer: 開封後的罐與軟袋沒有公布的冷凍天數，也不應該自己編一個。市售果菜泥解凍後會分成液體和固體，再也回不到原本的樣子。自己打的泥用製冰盒冷凍、凍硬後裝袋，是合理的習慣，而且一格就是很好用的單位：大約一次吃得完的份量，解凍多少就吃多少。袋子記得貼標籤。已經解凍、加熱或餵過的，不會再回到冷凍庫。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放在流理台上，而且只加熱一次。加熱後要攪透，再滴一點在手腕內側試溫——微波過的泥裡藏著熱點，攪一次不一定攪得到。
spoilage: 真空鈕按下去會響——不要打開，整罐丟掉。
軟袋鼓脹、滲漏或破損，或開封時嘶嘶作響、噴出來。
聞起來發酸、有發酵味或異味，或泥本身在冒泡。
瓶口、蓋子內側或吸嘴處出現霉。
tips: 一律舀一份到碗裡，不要就著容器餵。
開封時在罐子上寫下日期和時間。
每次使用前都檢查真空鈕和軟袋封邊。
未滿一歲的寶寶絕對不能吃蜂蜜——它可能帶有引起嬰兒肉毒桿菌中毒的孢子。

faq.q: 開封的嬰兒副食品罐可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2～3 天，而且前提是從來沒有直接從裡面餵過。

faq.q: 可以直接拿罐子餵寶寶嗎？
faq.a: 只有這一餐會整罐吃完才可以。只要餵過的湯匙或寶寶的嘴碰過，剩下的就必須丟掉。
按一下真空鈕，它不應該發出聲音。軟袋要檢查有沒有鼓脹、滲漏或破損；開封時嘶嘶響或噴出來的，全部丟掉。

faq.q: 外出把副食品裝在悶燒罐裡，中午再餵可以嗎？
faq.a: 不建議。悶燒罐只保溫、不加熱，溫度一路往下掉，等於讓一份低酸的混合食品在 4 °C 到 60 °C 之間泡一個早上，而吃它的寶寶免疫系統還沒發展完全。室溫的上限是兩小時，超過 32 °C 時只有一小時，這種天氣在台灣的夏天是常態。要帶出門就帶未開封的玻璃罐或軟袋、現開現餵；已經開過的請放保冷袋維持 4 °C 以下，並記得那也只有 2～3 天，而且前提是從來沒有直接就著容器餵過。
